channel.label: Channel {n}
channel.empty.title: Channel {n} is empty
channel.empty.hint: Open the address below on your phone or computer and upload cartoons here.
channel.none.title: There are no channels yet
channel.none.hint: Open the web interface, create a channel and upload cartoons into it.
web.offline: The TV is not connected to Wi-Fi. Hold MENU and choose Wi-Fi.
standby.hint: Press the power button when you want to come back.
limit.title: {name}, that's all for today.
limit.hint: A parent can add time in Settings or on the web.
menu.title: Settings
menu.hint.nav: Up/down arrows select, OK confirms, BACK closes
wifi.title: Wi-Fi networks
hotspot.title: Set up with a phone
hotspot.step1: 1. Join the Wi-Fi network “{ssid}” (no password) on your phone – or scan the QR code.
hotspot.step3: 3. Pick your home Wi-Fi and enter the password.
keyboard.hint: Arrows select, OK types, BACK deletes
wizard.welcome.title: Welcome!
wizard.welcome.text: Let's set up the TV. Use the arrows and the OK button on the remote.
wizard.language.title: Choose a language
wizard.wifi.title: Wi-Fi connection
wizard.wifi.text: Pick your home network. Over Wi-Fi you will upload cartoons from a phone or computer.
wizard.name.title: What is the child's name?
wizard.name.text: The TV will be named after the child. You can change the name later.
wizard.web.title: Uploading cartoons
wizard.web.text: Open this address on a phone or computer on the same Wi-Fi. There you create channels, upload cartoons and a photo.
wizard.web.offline: The TV is not on Wi-Fi. You will find the address later in Settings → Web address.
wizard.done.title: All set!
wizard.done.text: Up/down arrows change channels, left/right episodes, OK pauses. Hold MENU to open settings.
remote.learn.title: Learn remote
remote.learn.text: Press the button on the remote for: {action}
remote.learn.skip: Hold any button for 3 s to skip
confirm.title: Are you sure?
web.title: TV
web.channels.title: Channels
web.channels.intro: Every folder is one channel. Channels and episodes are ordered by name – to control the order, name files 01, 02, 03…
web.channels.new.name: Channel name (e.g. Peppa Pig)
web.channels.delete.confirm: Really delete channel “{name}” with all its files?
web.channels.drop: Drop files here or click to choose. Almost any format works (mp4, mkv, avi, mp3…).
web.settings.title: Settings
web.settings.tv_name.hint: Leave empty for an automatic name based on the child's name.
web.settings.avatar.hint: Shown at start-up, when switching channels and on the good-night screen.
web.settings.audio_languages.hint: Comma-separated codes (slk = Slovak, ces = Czech, eng = English). The first available language is picked automatically.
web.settings.parent_pin: Parent PIN for the on-TV settings
web.settings.hotspot_ssid: Name of the TV's own Wi-Fi (phone setup)
web.wifi.title: Wi-Fi
web.wifi.hotspot.hint: Handy in a hotel: join the TV's network with your phone, open http://kid.tv and pick the hotel Wi-Fi.
web.wifi.connecting: Connecting… this page will refresh shortly. If you are on the TV's hotspot, switch your phone to the home Wi-Fi.
web.remote.title: Remote control
web.remote.intro: Teach the remote by clicking an action and then pressing a button on the remote.
web.remote.learning: Press a button on the remote…
web.system.title: System
web.system.wizard: Run the wizard on the TV
web.setup.title: Connect the TV to Wi-Fi
web.setup.intro: Pick your Wi-Fi network and enter the password. Once connected, the TV's hotspot turns off and the TV is reachable on your home network.
update.confirm: Update the TV to version {version}? It turns off for a moment and starts again by itself.
update.downloading.title: Downloading the update
update.installing.title: Updating the TV
update.installing.text: This takes about a minute. Do not unplug it, it starts again by itself.
update.none: The TV is up to date (version {version})
update.unavailable: No downloadable version was found on GitHub
update.check_failed: Could not check for a new version. Is the TV online?
update.done: The TV is updated to version {version}
update.rolled_back: The new version did not start, the TV went back to {version}
update.failed: The update failed. Details are on the web page under System.
web.update.title: Update
web.update.check_error.not-found: repository not found – is it public?
web.update.state.rolled_back: version {to} did not start, back on {from}
web.update.banner: A new TV version {version} is available.
web.update.progress: The TV downloads the new version, installs it and restarts. It takes about a minute; this page reloads by itself.
web.update.js.failed: It did not work, the TV stayed on the old version.
web.settings.auto_update: Check for a new version once a day (installs only after you confirm)
